div.span: - Tasks register in the private DNS namespace service.local, so the frontend never needs a task IP address. New tasks are discoverable as soon as they are healthy.

div.div: - Where the numbers live: ecsdemo-frontend/cdk/app.py sets desired_count=3, min_capacity=1, max_capacity=10, target_utilization_percent=30 and 30 s cooldowns.
- Auxiliary: CloudWatch Logs collects /ecs/ecsdemo-* through the awslogs driver. It is not part of the scaling loop.
- Cost: roughly USD 0.50 to 1.00 per hour. Run cdk destroy in reverse order when you finish.
